releases.name: v0.6.4 — idle images are evicted
releases.body: A free-lane Lisp image is closed after 10 idle minutes (NODECODE_MAGPIE_IDLE_MS, 0 disables). A running eval is never swept, and definitions replay from the history file on the next call.

releases.name: v0.6.3 — tool_choice:none keeps the free image
releases.body: A tool_choice:"none" free request now runs the eval image as well; client tools are refused inside the loop (the model gets a tool error and answers in text), so the reply has no tool_calls. A max_tokens below 256 still uses the transcript bridge.

releases.name: v0.6.2 — eval ids stay addressable
releases.body: Eval ids keep increasing across plugin-host restarts (a new image starts after the highest id in the log), and (magpie-eval-status N) for an eval from an earlier image answers from the log instead of reporting an unknown eval.

releases.name: v0.6.1 — vision cache and retry
releases.body: look now reuses the description of an unchanged file with the same question (rewriting the file or asking a different question describes it again), and a briefly-restarting gateway route (dropped connection, 429, 5xx) is retried once before the plugin moves to the next vision model.

releases.name: v0.6.0 — background eval log
releases.body: A background eval that outlives its yield window now appends its exit to a per-session log, so a rebuilt image can read it with (magpie-eval-log) after a plugin-host restart.
